We are not the first to make this trip.
Just the slowest.

Three mornings that look nothing like each other.
April 2027, Seoul.

You will not see Seoul.
You will run it.

#flyway #runseoul

Bangkok gives you everything but this.

#flyway #runseoul

One flat. One vertical. One four hundred years old.
Nothing repeated.

#flyway #runseoul

Six kilometres, not one traffic light.
You run west and the sun goes with you.

#flyway #hanriver

Two hundred metres up.
One rule: we meet at the top.

#flyway #namsan

By ten it belongs to everyone.
At half seven it is yours.

#flyway #gwanghwamun

Sixteen degrees.
That is the entire pitch.

#flyway #runseoul

You cannot practise a hill that does not exist.

#flyway #namsan

Everything else is training.
This one you have to fly to.

Nobody runs a route we have not walked first.

Routes locked. Dates close.
The rest is you.
